reason: The definition and division children refute other scholars' definitions and argue at length about which paths are genuine, so they deserve their own headings.
The illustration and special-qualities children give extended explanations of the accumulation path's kinds, realisation, abandonment and qualities.
The first two children are short identifications, but the third (activity-clear-realisation) discusses the sixteen moments at length and answers objections.
The children explain the path of seeing's definition (with refutation of other views), divisions, special qualities and synonyms in substantive paragraphs.
The two children (enterer and abider) only tally the numbers of subtypes of stream-enterers with no discussion of their own.
The two children (enterer and abider) only tally the numbers of subtypes of the once-returner with no discussion of their own.
The enterer child only tallies subtypes, but the abider child raises and answers several doubts and cites the Compendium at length.
Each of the five kinds of form-realm goer is explained with its own conditions and subdivisions, several at length.
The enterer and abider children analyse the arhat's path, its many divisions and the classification of trainees at length.
The seven children are long discussions raising and answering doubts on levels, knowledges, fruits, the wheel of Dharma and faculty change.
The five children analyse the factors of awakening (substance vs imputed, the seven sets, levels, confirmed faith, the ten qualities) at length with citations.
The eight children discuss the kinds of knowledge, their number, aspects, levels, objects, possession and acquisition in extended analysis with verses.
